title: Are data centers a good deal for Ohio? 5 numbers from a new study raise questions
why_it_matters_hint: A new study questions whether data centres are a good deal for Ohio (headline only).
notes: Cleveland.com blocked (403). Ohio Capital Journal (8 Oct) runs a headline about a study saying a construction ban would be better for Ohio than the status quo, which may be the same study, but this could not be verified and was not used.
